neighbours.label: subordinating words that open a clause ('when', 'whether', 'once', 'the day that')
fire: And then when the euro goes down, the dollar rises.
Finding out whether or not the wine is vegan is not easy.
The day that we became parents changed everything.
Once the rain stops, we will leave for the station.
Nobody knows whether the plan will work.
When we heard the news, we called our parents.
She asked whether the train was on time.
As soon as the bell rang, the children ran outside.
quiet: And then the euro goes down and the dollar rises.
Finding out about vegan wine is not easy.
Becoming parents changed everything for us.
The rain stops and we leave for the station.
Nobody knows much about the plan.
We heard the news and called our parents.
She asked about the train schedule.
The bell rang and the children ran outside.
